## How this was found, and the one thing NOT proven

Found while verifying whether Gerrit change 2673 had landed. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 459e1d1b099f origin/main` returned **NO**, but the change HAD merged — as `9e6a0e436520`, found by `Change-Id`. That prompted a sweep of `is-ancestor` uses across the repo, of which this script was the only site where the rewritten sha changes an operator-visible answer.

**Not proven:** I did not establish *why* `feature/s1-windows-sweep-probe` was rebased on submit while the other four branches were not. The rebase-on-submit explanation fits (`main` is Rebase-If-Necessary, and the branch is exactly 1 commit ahead of main with its Change-Id present under a different sha), but I did not test the alternative — e.g. the branch tip being an amended patchset never submitted in that exact form, with an equivalent commit landing separately. Whoever claims this should settle that before writing the fix, because it changes whether Change-Id lookup alone is sufficient or whether patch-id equivalence is also needed.

## Store-health context from the same pass

`rebar doctor` on this store: **exit 0**, 0 stale locks, all six lock legs free, all three MCP client configs ok. Its 17 findings are all pre-existing `mis-escalated` link records (blocking-link promotion recording an endpoint that differs from the resolved comparable pair) — unrelated to this bug and not new.

Also observed and worth a separate look by whoever picks up the "checks that don't check" sweep: the CREATE of this ticket returned `push_status: {state: pending, reason: push-transport-failed, detail: "git timed out after 30s", unpushed: 3}`, i.e. three ticket commits not yet shared to `origin/tickets`. `rebar doctor` did **not** surface that condition in the output I read. I am flagging this as UNVERIFIED rather than as a finding: I read only the tail of doctor's output, so a sync section may exist above it. If it does not, "store health command does not report unshared writes" belongs in the same sweep as this bug — a store that reports healthy while three writes are invisible to every other session is the same failure shape.
